newsitem.title: UK: London U.S. stocks mixed in quiet pre-data trading.
newsitem.headline: London U.S. stocks mixed in quiet pre-data trading.

text.p: U.S. shares were mixed with an overall firmer bias on Friday as the market stayed quiet, awaiting key labour market data, dealers said.
"There's very little going on today ahead of the payroll figures but we should see the market go better if the numbers are in line," said one.
The April payroll figure, due at 1230 GMT, is forecast at 211,000 against a previous 175,000.
Unemployment for the month is seen at 5.2 percent, unchanged from last time and average hourly earnings are forecast at 0.3 percent compared with 0.4 percent.
Gainers included Intel, up $1/4 to $154 and Philip Morris, up $1/4 to $39-1/4.

After-hours news that the Justice Department joined a "whistleblower" lawsuit filed against the aerospace giant by a former employee of a Boeing subcontractor took the shares down $1/2 to $98-1/2, dealers said.
